result.question: Compare the net income of Apple and Nvidia in their most recent fiscal years.
result.answer: In their most recent fiscal years, Apple reported net income of $112,010 million (approximately $112.0 billion) for fiscal year 2025, the year ended September 27, 2025 [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p001]. Nvidia reported net income of $120,067 million (approximately $120.1 billion) for fiscal year 2026, the year ended January 25, 2026 [0001045810-26-000021:item-15-p005]. Nvidia's net income was higher than Apple's in their respective most recent fiscal years. It should be noted that the two companies' fiscal years end on different dates — Apple's fiscal year 2025 ended September 27, 2025, while Nvidia's fiscal year 2026 ended January 25, 2026 — so the figures cover overlapping but not identical time periods [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p001] [0001045810-26-000021:item-15-p005].
